name: 磁吸360度旋转车载手机支架款

category.leaf: 磁吸出风口车载手机支架

description: 强磁吸持秒放秒取、360度旋转任意视角、稳固不掉、不挡视线不扰信号

styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep charcoal #24262A for dramatic hero, structure and closing shots; clean white #FFFFFF for operation and trust shots; light neutral grey #E9EAEC for macro and split panels
styleLock.lightingSystem: neutral-cool studio lighting; soft spotlight and controlled rim highlights with gentle floor reflections on dark panels, bright even high-key with soft contact shadows on light panels
styleLock.surfaceSystem: smooth seamless gradient backdrop and matte light-grey panel #E9EAEC, no texture clutter
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines only, white #FFFFFF headlines on dark panels and charcoal #2D2D2D on light panels
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and rounded rectangular label strips, single gold accent #C9974C
styleLock.presentationRules: stable product scale and placement, hero angle repeats across benefit and closing shots, generic unbranded smartphone #2A2A2A as companion prop
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium automotive-tech ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal background #24262A, clean white #FFFFFF, light neutral grey #E9EAEC, charcoal text #2D2D2D and one champagne-gold accent #C9974C; neutral-cool studio lighting, soft spotlights with controlled rim highlights and gentle floor reflections on dark panels, bright even high-key light with soft contact shadows on light panels; modern geometric sans-serif headlines only; consistent rounded rectangular label strips and thin-line icons in the single gold accent; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement with a generic unbranded smartphone as companion prop; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 暗场聚光低角度开场，一眼立住金属磁吸质感，赢下点击
shots.camera: low angle looking slightly upward, front 3/4 view, full product visible and centered
shots.lighting: soft spotlights from above and behind, controlled rim highlights on the metallic ring, gentle floor reflection grounded by a soft contact shadow
shots.background: deep charcoal seamless stage backdrop #24262A with soft spotlight glow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a low angle looking slightly upward at a front 3/4 view, the full product centered and filling 60-70% of the frame, grounded by a gentle floor reflection and a soft contact shadow. Dramatic soft spotlights from above and behind, controlled rim highlights on the metallic ring. Deep charcoal seamless stage backdrop #24262A with a soft spotlight glow surrounding the product so the dark field and the metal read as one complete balanced hero composition. 8K, commercial automotive e-commerce quality. Negative: no brand text or logo, no props, no hands, no watermark, no extra text, no lens flare streaks, no cut-off edges, no floating product without contact shadow.

provenance.notes: 从 9 张车载磁吸支架爆款长图切片提炼；已剥离源品牌字（含首屏品牌字样）、会员二维码与原文案，预留空块均重写为完整构图；手机一律为通用无品牌手机，产品以 {product} 承接；同行对比、磁组爆炸图、微距磁阵、单手操作等版式提炼为通用视觉语法；信任镜改用磁吸满贴接触面与稳固持机等可验证细节，不写入任何资质/检测承诺。
